sources.name: Gentzkow-Shapiro-Taddy Congressional Record partisan phrases
sources.citation: Gentzkow, Shapiro and Taddy, Congressional Record for the 43rd-114th Congresses: Parsed Speeches and Phrase Counts, Stanford Libraries, 2018
sources.notes: Top 1000 partisan stemmed bigrams per session; positive scores are Republican, negative Democratic. Candidate generator only: partisanship is not loadedness. Attribution required (see ATTRIBUTION.md).

sources.name: Congressional Record floor speech, GovInfo (2017 onward)
sources.license: Public domain: US government work (17 U.S.C. 105); speaker party from GovInfo MODS metadata
sources.citation: U.S. Government Publishing Office, Congressional Record (daily edition), via GovInfo
sources.notes: Crawled by tools/download-crec.js (sampled session days), not a pinned archive, so data:download skips it. Partisanship is not loadedness: rules ship only as tested mirror pairs.

sources.name: NewsWCL50 word choice and labeling annotations
sources.citation: Hamborg et al., Automated Identification of Media Bias by Word Choice and Labeling in News Articles, JCDL 2019
sources.notes: 10 events (2018) covered by left, centre and right outlets. Used as a political-balance diagnostic: flag rates on each side's annotated wording. Too small and event-bound for rule mining.
